mona (pm): Starting a short thread for a different rollout idea: "canary credits" + confidence-based progressive exposure. Want a safe way to let tenants test the low-bit route with per-tenant budgets and automatic pauses when model confidence drops. Thoughts?

mona (pm): High level: assign each opt-in tenant a small 'canary credit' balance (tokens / requests) they can spend testing the new path. Credits replenish slowly if signals are healthy. This limits blast radius and makes behavior explainable to customers.

ezra (eng): Interesting. infra implications: flag schema must include "canary_credits", "replenish_rate", and "confidence_threshold". Controller will deduct credits per request and pause route when balance hits 0. We can surface reason codes.

ben (sre): Circuit breaker: auto-pause tenant if either confidence < threshold for 10m OR p95 > baseline * 1.8 for 5m OR error spike > 0.5%. When paused set flag state to "paused:<reason>" and page SRE only if multiple tenants in region pause within 20m.

ivy (data): Define "confidence" as a composite score: rolling semantic-similarity (embed cosine), token-level perplexity proxy, and a small rerank consistency metric. We can composite into 0..1. Thresholds: start at 0.85 but allow per-tenant tuning. For small cohorts use Bayesian posterior intervals and require 3 consecutive windows showing drop before hard pause.

lina (cs): From CS: customers will like limited credits (they feel in control). We need consent UI that shows remaining credits and a link that explains auto-pause logic + how to request manual review. Also add an opt-out that disables auto-replenish.

mona (pm): Proposed rollout steps (compact):
- internal dry-warm mirror for 6h (no billing, pre-warm caches).
- invite 8 early adopter tenants with 500 credits each, 1:1 A/B for first 2h, then observe 24h.
- if green, replenish 50 credits/day and widen to 60 tenants with dynamic replenishes.
- regional widen only after 48h of stable confidence and infra metrics.

ezra (eng): Example flag payload (stringified for infra):
{"name":"prod.ff.routing.canary_credits.lowbit","default":"false","allowed_tenants":"[\"acct_22\"]","canary_credits":"500","replenish_rate":"50_per_day","confidence_threshold":"0.85","warmup_rps":"12","dry_warm":"true","owner":"mona"}

ben (sre): Warmup policy: async cache prefill with throttle 10rps/tenant, exponential backoff on failures. Also add a system-wide emergency throttle when GPU memory pressure > 70%.

ivy (data): Analysis plan: report composite confidence, p50/p95 latency, cost delta per-tenant, and conversion signal. Use 6h rolling windows and require posterior prob(new worse than baseline by >0.02) < 0.05 to increase credits. If >0.95 probability worse, immediately pause and notify.

lina (cs): UI suggestions: show a small progress bar of credits, last pause reason, and a "request review" button that opens a CS ticket prefilled with diagnostics. We'll also add email templates for pause/unpause.

mona (pm): Tooling asks: 1) Controller emits human-readable stop reasons and reason_codes; 2) Flag API supports per-tenant credits and manual credit adjust; 3) Dashboard shows credit burn rate and projected days left.

ezra (eng): Will implement credits in flag service and a lightweight controller. Controller will also expose an API to top-up credits and to set per-tenant confidence overrides. ETA: first PR by next Tue.

ben (sre): I'll add an oncall playbook: when auto-pause triggers page SRE only if >=3 tenants in region paused in 20m OR if system GPU pressure triggered pause. Manual unpause requires SRE ack. Also log reason_code to tenant audit.

ivy (data): I'll build the composite confidence pipeline and a notebook for near-real-time checks. ETA: gating notebook + dashboard panels by Mon.

lina (cs): I'll draft the consent UI copy and customer-facing docs; also prepare a short FAQ explaining credits and auto-pause behavior. ETA: Fri.

flagbot: Created flag prod.ff.routing.canary_credits.lowbit in staging at 2081234567.

mona (pm): Actions recap: ezra: flag + controller + top-up API (ETA Tue). ivy: confidence pipeline + panels (ETA Mon). ben: circuit breaker + playbook (ETA Wed). lina: CS UX + templates (ETA Fri). If no objections schedule internal dry-warm next Wed. pls ack.
